title: Q-STD-ledger-cloudevents: Write every ops/*.jsonl ledger row as a CloudEvents 1.0 event
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** OPEN-STANDARDS-1 register entry `cloudevents` is planned or partial in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe cloudevents
**Status:** open

foundation/ledger.py appends rows in per-ledger shapes. Wrap each appended row with seed/scripts/openstd.py cloudevent (type io.ultrastable.<ledger>.<kind>, source /<tenant>/<loop>, data = the existing row) behind a reader that accepts both shapes, then mark `cloudevents` supported in seed/standards/standards.json.

**Prediction:** ledger_rows_cloudevents_share >= 0.5 within 168 h

**Out of scope:** Rewriting history: existing rows stay as written; readers accept both shapes.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation openstd --probe cloudevents` exits 0.
